Class DialogHelper

java.lang.Object
com.duck.DialogHelper
public class DialogHelper extends Object
Utility class with static methods for constructing and displaying modal dialogs. Provides dialogs for creating transactions, budgets, saving goals, editing profiles, changing passwords, and adding categories.

    • showTransactionDialog

      public static Transaction showTransactionDialog(Account account, AppSettings.TransactionType preset)
      Shows a dialog to create a new transaction with an optional preset type. Provides fields for type (Income / Expense), category, amount, and date.
      Parameters:
      account - the account to associate the transaction with
      preset - the preselected transaction type, or null for no default
      Returns:
      a new Transaction, or null if the dialog was cancelled
